commercialCleaning.title: Commercial Cleaning
commercialCleaning.description: Professional commercial checklist to keep facilities clean, hygienic, and client-ready.
commercialCleaning.recommended: Recommended for businesses that need recurring, structured cleaning and sanitization.

daily: Routine Cleaning: This includes tasks like dusting, vacuuming, mopping, emptying trash, cleaning restrooms, and sanitizing common areas.
Window Cleaning: Ensuring windows and glass surfaces are clean and streak-free.
Floor Care: Maintaining various types of flooring, including carpet cleaning, stripping and waxing, and polishing.
Restroom Cleaning and Sanitization: Thorough cleaning and disinfection of restrooms to maintain hygiene.
High-Touch Surface Cleaning: Regularly cleaning and sanitizing surfaces like door handles, light switches, and handrails.
Trash Removal and Recycling: Implementing proper waste management and recycling practices.
Kitchen and Breakroom Cleaning: Cleaning and sanitizing kitchen areas, including appliances, counters, and sinks.
Dusting and Surface Cleaning: Dusting furniture, shelves, and other surfaces, often including high-dusting.

postConstruction.title: Post Construction Cleaning
postConstruction.description: Structured post-construction cleaning in phases, from rough cleanup to final move-in sanitization.
postConstruction.recommended: Recommended after renovations and construction projects before tours, inspections, or move-in.

main: PHASE 1: ROUGH - This phase prepares a clean space free of construction dust and materials for a final contractor walk-through. Stickers and film are removed from appliances, construction dust is wiped and removed from all surfaces and floors are thoroughly cleaned. Excess paint and caulk are scraped and windows are thoroughly cleaned.

PHASE 2: DETAIL - This phase prepares the home for realtor home tours and open house events. Surfaces and trim work are thoroughly cleaned along side of a full deep cleaning service. This cleaning provides a crisp and clean home ready for viewing and foot traffic.
PHASE 3: FINAL - This final phase provides a detailed and thorough deep clean and sanitization for move-in day.
Interior windows clean and free of smudges
Dust interior window sills and blinds
Scrub interior window casing
Baseboards and door frames wiped down
Sweep, vacuum, and mop floors
Dust surfaces, ceiling fan, and ledges
